interfaces.name: MdnsPluginPlatformResult

Result of getPluginPlatform(). Useful for validating that calls are routed
through the expected platform bridge.

properties.name: platform
properties.docs: Platform implementation that produced this result.

interfaces.name: MdnsBroadcastResult
interfaces.docs:
Result of startBroadcast(). Indicates whether advertising is active
and the final service name. On failure, `error` is true and `errorMessage`
describes the issue.

properties.name: error
properties.docs: True if the operation failed.

properties.name: errorMessage
properties.docs: Error description or null on success.

properties.name: name
properties.docs: Final (possibly uniquified) service instance name. Empty on failure.

properties.name: publishing
properties.docs: Whether the advertiser is currently active.

interfaces.name: MdnsBroadcastOptions
interfaces.docs: Options for starting a Bonjour/mDNS advertisement.

tags.text:
- The `type` **must** end with a dot (`.`). If omitted, the implementation appends it.
- Instance `name` should be short and human-readable; the OS may append `" (n)"` to ensure uniqueness.
- Android NSD does not expose TXT records to other apps; advertising TXT is supported on iOS.
- Native implementations guard publish with a timeout and return `error: true` instead of
  leaving the Promise pending when the OS does not deliver a publish callback.
- Only one advertisement is active at a time. Starting a new one stops the previous one first.
tags.name: remarks

interfaces.name: MdnsStopResult
interfaces.docs:
Result of stopBroadcast(). Indicates whether the advertiser is active
after the call (normally false) and includes error information.

properties.name: error
properties.docs: True if an error occurred while stopping.

properties.name: errorMessage
properties.docs: Error description or null on success.

properties.name: publishing
properties.docs: Whether the advertiser remains active (should be false on success).

interfaces.name: MdnsDiscoverResult
interfaces.docs: Result of discover(). Contains normalized services and error information.

properties.name: error
properties.docs: True if discovery encountered an error (partial results may still be present).

properties.name: errorMessage
properties.docs: Error description or null when no error occurred.

properties.name: servicesFound
properties.docs: Convenience count equal to services.length.

properties.name: services
properties.docs: Normalized list of discovered services.

interfaces.name: MdnsService
interfaces.docs:
Normalized description of a discovered Bonjour/mDNS service.
Returned from {@link mDNSPlugin.discover}.

tags.text:
- `hosts` contains resolved IPv4/IPv6 numeric addresses (no DNS names).
- iOS returns `txt` when present. Android (NSD) does not expose TXT records via public APIs,
  so `txt` is usually omitted on Android.
- `domain` is typically `"local."`.
tags.name: remarks

properties.name: name
properties.docs: Instance name of the service (may be uniqued by the OS, e.g. "My App (2)").

properties.name: type
properties.docs: Full service type including the trailing dot, e.g. `"_http._tcp."`.

properties.name: domain
properties.docs: Service domain; typically `"local."`.

properties.name: port
properties.docs: TCP port the service advertises.

properties.name: hosts
properties.docs: Resolved numeric IP addresses (IPv4/IPv6).

properties.name: txt

tags.text: Not all services publish TXT data.
tags.name: remarks

properties.docs: TXT dictionary (key → value). Usually present on iOS; Android NSD does not populate this.

tags.text:
- The `name` filter matches the normalized name and also accepts prefix matches
  (to handle OS-added `" (n)"` suffixes).
- When `useNW` is `true` on iOS, discovery uses `NWBrowser` for better P2P behavior.
- Discovery is timeboxed. Concurrent discovery requests are serialized or safely replace
  the previous native session so old callbacks cannot complete a newer request.
tags.name: remarks

properties.name: type
properties.docs: Service type (including the trailing dot).

properties.name: name
properties.docs: Optional instance name filter (prefix-safe).

properties.name: timeout
properties.docs: Discovery timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: useNW
properties.docs: iOS-only hint to use `NWBrowser` instead of `NetServiceBrowser`.
